# ECL scripts index of the v1.3 records (WizardWorks CD; lane cab-v13) — generated by decode/tools/ecldis.py --all --bin decode/bin/v13/dax; counts and vectors only, no game text

Per record: `ECL<n>_<rec>.ecl.txt` = disassembly from the 5 header vectors (recursive traversal; IF: both successors; ON_GOTO/ON_GOSUB tables; data tables named by GET_TABLE/SAVE_TABLE are not executed). Addresses are VM addresses (record byte 2 = 8000h). Spec: `decode/ecl/ECL_VM.md`.
